caseStudies.title: OMC power Energy Measurement and Monitoring
caseStudies.desc:
The mobile industry has been depending on expensive and highly polluting diesel generators. OMC is changing that fact. OMC connect the telecom base station to our local smart power plants, and power is provided on a KWH consumed basis. OMC Power is offering telecom tower companies reliable and affordable electricity through it innovative ABC model, a solution which not only delivers reduced operating costs but also reduced environmental impact. As pioneers of the much talked about innovative distributed energy model - 'ABC' Model, 
We provide clean and reliable energy access to: 
'A'nchor customers (Telecom Towers), 
'B'usinesses (small and medium scale rural businesses) 
'C'ommunities (rural households) through our smart mini-grids in remote villages of Uttar Pradesh, one of india's largest states with the most intense shortage in the access to reliable energy.
caseStudies.resultLabel: Automated alarm-to-ticket workflow with zero manual intervention

caseStudies.resultLabel: Framework agreement for continuous hardware supply in KSA
